page.overview:
What is Khaosrealm?

The Khaosrealm, also known as the Realm of Chaos, is one of the six main realms in the video game series Mortal Kombat.

The Khaosrealm is a world where chaos is practiced by its inhabitants as a religion, so, unlike other realms, it has no form of government whatsoever. Therefore, the Khaosrealmers reflect their world's chaotic nature, and hold absolute freedom and change in the highest esteem, relishing in chaos and living in an absolute [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Anarchy anarchy]. It is the polar opposite of Orderrealm.

The forces of Orderrealm seek to control Khaosrealm and its vast reserves of water. According to Mortal Kombat: Deception's Konquest mode, the Khaosrealm is also home to a pool of aging located at A-5 of the realm at the end of a small labyrinth, which appears to age anyone that ventures through it, or establishes them to believe 'they have changed' or they 'feel older.' The Khaosrealm is also home of a cemetery that Khaosrealmers hold sacred. Because chaos is practiced as a religion, many temples are found throughout Khaosrealm, where holy men are seen praying in front of the entrance. Khaosrealm possesses geographical features that seem to defy the laws of physics, such as floating rock formations. Khaosrealmers use highly advanced portals to travel between the formations. Apparently, Khaosrealm is said to have been a normal world until at some point in the distant past, the God of Chaos unleashed "the Tempest." This was responsible for the realm's transformation and its fragmentation, and is also thought to have caused collective amnesia among the inhabitants of the realm.

In the new timeline, Khaosrealm does not exist. However, due to the arrangement with Havik, Rain flooded a capital city of Seido under the command of Havik, in the aftermath of the catastrophe Havik attempts to rebuild and rechristen Orderrealm as Khaosrealm.
